findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: Providing a specially crafted filename that includes shell metacharacters
findings.assumptions: The program is intended to read from a file, but the filename is directly passed to `inFile.open()`. If the filename is attacker-controlled, it could potentially lead to command injection if the program is run in a vulnerable environment.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: Providing a specially crafted input that includes shell metacharacters
findings.assumptions: The program reads words from a file, but the input is directly stored without any validation. If the input is attacker-controlled, it could potentially lead to command injection if the program is run in a vulnerable environment.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: Providing a specially crafted input that includes shell metacharacters
findings.assumptions: The program reads the starting and final words from standard input, but the input is directly stored without any validation. If the input is attacker-controlled, it could potentially lead to command injection if the program is run in a vulnerable environment.

findings.title: Buffer Over-read
findings.assumptions: The program compares characters of two words to find adjacent words in the word bank. If the words have different lengths, this could lead to a buffer over-read.
